messages:
Maya P.: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small feature toggle to rollforward structured-output (function-calling) support behind a compat flag. PR: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pulls/8423 Can we sync on client SDK behavior + guardrails before I schedule the canary?
Liam C.: looking now. the plan in the PR is: server exposes new `structured_output_v2` flag, default false. when false we keep legacy JSON shape + shim on server side. when true we return the new tool-calling envelope to callers. clients should treat this as opt-in behavior.
Priya S.: important for mobile: if SDK sees unknown `tool_call` envelope while flag=false (older client), it should surface as plain text, not crash. iOS/Android QA needs a clear fallback path.
Alex R.: agree w/ Priya. also we should make SDK contract explicit: `compat_mode: strict|lenient` client-side setting. default `lenient` for now. docs in the PR mention `lenient` treats unknown items as opaque strings.
Maya P.: can we add a runtime guard so clients that incorrectly parse don't send sensitive telemetry? i.e., if parsing fails, SDK stops sending tool-call payloads back to server until user updates.
Tim O.: who will own the metric for regressions? propose `so.fncall.errors_per_1k_requests` + alert if >5 for canary audience. Also add `so.client_parse_success_rate` by SDK version.
Liam C.: noted. I'll wire those in the observability config. suggestion for canary audiences: internal alpha (0.5%), internal beta (5%), then progressive ramp to 25% with rollback gates.
Maya P.: sounds good. can we add an emergency kill switch that also flips server-side shim-mode (force legacy envelope) so we can quickly remediate user-facing breakage?
Alex R.: yes — feature flag has `mode: off|shim|on`. default `shim`. Transition plan in the PR: alpha->shim->on. CLI to flip: `rctl flags set structured_output_v2 --mode=shim`
Priya S.: iOS QA: request a small test matrix: SDK v1.9 (lenient), SDK v2.0 (strict), toggles shim/on/off, and simulated network failures. I'll add to the mobile test board.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created by Maya P.: rollout job #3247 queued for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z (canary: 0.5%).
sre-bot: FYI — added alert `SO.FunctionCall.ErrorSpike` to the prod on-call policy, threshold 10 errors/min during canary.
Tim O.: small nit on naming: flag used in SDK should be `redwood_so_v2` (shorter). let's keep server side name `structured_output_v2` and map in SDK.
Maya P.: ack. i'll update the PR with the mapping + add a short snippet for SDK implementers. snippet: ```json
{
  "flag": "redwood_so_v2",
  "mode": "shim",
  "audience": { "percent": 0.5, "type": "internal" }
}
```
Liam C.: i'll push the observability dashboards today and tag Priya for the QA checklist.
Priya S.: thanks — i'll start scheduling devices for the matrix. report back if we see parse errors >2% on internal alpha. :thumbsup:
Alex R.: LGTM. once dashboards and QA are green, rollforward window = next Tue midnight UTC.
Maya P.: thanks team. leaving the canary schedule tentative until dashboards + QA sign-off. I'll ping again when PR is updated.
